xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Conversation persistence remains Conversation-owned; the ref excludes ordinary conversation, calls, payments and notifications.
A Reel message does not trigger AI; a subsequent text question uses stored shared-Reel context.
Socket event emission precedes create_message RPC return; client reception/reconciliation need not complete before that return.
